basics.name: Ambarish S. Ghatpande, PhD
basics.label: University of Pennsylvania Perelman School of Medicine
basics.summary: Brain researcher with a background in ion channel biophysics, synaptic physiology and neuronal circuits and surgical neu-rophysiology. Current interests are in acquiring and analyzing high-density silicon probe recordings from cortical and hip-pocampal organoids in vitro and after transplantation into rat and pig brains; analyzing neural population dynamics in be-having model mammalian species (rat, pig) and organoids.

team member in projects involving human brain organoid transplantation in rat and pig cortex
responsible for in vitro characterization of human cortical and hippocampal organoids using extracellular recordings with multi-electrode silicon probes
contributing to secondary analysis of neural population dynamics of behaving rats and pigsAccomplishments
